definitions.name: clw_file_code
definitions.equation:
clw_file_code (file_bytes:num->byte) <=>
    !i. i<97 ==> file_bytes(0x2417d0+i)=EL i openssl_cleanse_mc

definitions.name: clw_reference_code
definitions.equation:
clw_reference_code (image:int64->byte) <=>
    !i. i<97 ==> image(word(0x102417d0+i))=EL i openssl_cleanse_mc

definitions.name: clw_layout
definitions.equation: clw_layout p n <=> lw_layout p p n

definitions.name: clw_memory
definitions.equation: clw_memory image p n high_first = lw_memory image p p n high_first

definitions.name: clw_state
definitions.equation:
clw_state (image:int64->byte) (p:int64) n high_first =
    x86state_RECORD (word 0x102417d0)
      (\r:(4)word. if r=word 7 then p
                  else if r=word 6 then word n
                  else if r=word 4 then word 0x300008
                  else word 0)
      (\z:(5)word. word 0) (\k:(3)word. word 0) (word 2)
      (clw_memory image p n high_first) []

definitions.name: clw_read
definitions.equation: clw_read p n a <=> fb_read p p n a

definitions.name: clw_write
definitions.equation: clw_write p n a <=> lw_image_write a \/ lw_pagecover p n a

definitions.name: clw_ordinary
definitions.equation: clw_ordinary p n a <=> fb_ordinary p p n a

definitions.name: clw_scalar_pre
definitions.equation:
clw_scalar_pre image p n high_first <=>
    bp_e2_cleanse_pre 0x102417d0 (word 0x300008) (word 0x400000) p n
      (clw_memory image p n high_first) (clw_read p n) (clw_write p n)
      lw_execute (clw_ordinary p n) (clw_state image p n high_first)

definitions.name: clw_machine
definitions.equation:
clw_machine image p n high_first =
    (clw_state image p n high_first,fb_initial_abi)

definitions.name: clw_full_pre
definitions.equation:
clw_full_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image p n high_first <=>
    fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding
      (read memory (FST(clw_machine image p n high_first))) /\
    bp_e2_cleanse_pre 0x102417d0 (word 0x300008) (word 0x400000) p n
      (clw_memory image p n high_first) (clw_read p n) (clw_write p n)
      lw_execute (clw_ordinary p n) (FST(clw_machine image p n high_first)) /\
    fb_abi_initial_fields (SND(clw_machine image p n high_first)) /\
    (!a. fb_tls_page a ==> clw_read p n a /\ clw_ordinary p n a) /\
    assurance_canonical48 (val(read ABI_FS_BASE
      (SND(clw_machine image p n high_first)))) /\
    (!a. lw_image_domain a ==> clw_read p n a /\ clw_ordinary p n a /\
          (lw_execute a <=> lw_image_execute a) /\
          (clw_write p n a <=> lw_image_write a))

definitions.name: lw_image_domain
definitions.equation: lw_image_domain a <=> 0x10000000 <= a /\ a < 0x1048a000

definitions.name: lw_image_read
definitions.equation: lw_image_read a <=> lw_image_domain a

definitions.name: lw_image_execute
definitions.equation: lw_image_execute a <=> 0x100c5000 <= a /\ a < 0x10344000

definitions.name: lw_image_write
definitions.equation: lw_image_write a <=> 0x10484000 <= a /\ a < 0x1048a000

definitions.name: lw_pagecover
definitions.equation:
lw_pagecover (p:int64) n a <=>
    ~(n = 0) /\ 4096 * (val p DIV 4096) <= a /\
    a < 4096 * ((val p + n - 1) DIV 4096 + 1)

definitions.name: lw_overlay_domain
definitions.equation:
lw_overlay_domain p q n a <=>
    (0x300000 <= a /\ a < 0x301000) \/
    lw_pagecover p n a \/ lw_pagecover q n a

definitions.name: lw_layout
definitions.equation:
lw_layout p q n <=>
    !a. ~(lw_image_domain a /\ lw_overlay_domain p q n a)

definitions.name: lw_reference_code
definitions.equation:
lw_reference_code (image:int64->byte) <=>
    !i. i < 95 ==> image(word(0x10241840+i)) = EL i crypto_memcmp_mc

definitions.name: lw_memory
definitions.equation:
lw_memory (image:int64->byte) p q n different (a:int64) =
    if 0x300008 <= val a /\ val a < 0x300010
    then word (0x400000 DIV (256 EXP (val a-0x300008)))
    else if lw_overlay_domain p q n (val a)
         then if different /\ a = q then word 255 else word 128
         else image a

definitions.name: lw_state
definitions.equation:
lw_state (image:int64->byte) (p:int64) (q:int64) n different =
    x86state_RECORD (word 0x10241840)
      (\r:(4)word. if r=word 7 then p
                  else if r=word 6 then q
                  else if r=word 2 then word n
                  else if r=word 4 then word 0x300008
                  else word 0)
      (\z:(5)word. word 0) (\k:(3)word. word 0) (word 2)
      (lw_memory image p q n different) []

definitions.name: lw_read
definitions.equation: lw_read p q n a <=> lw_image_read a \/ lw_overlay_domain p q n a

definitions.name: lw_execute
definitions.equation: lw_execute a <=> lw_image_execute a

definitions.name: lw_ordinary
definitions.equation: lw_ordinary p q n a <=> lw_image_domain a \/ lw_overlay_domain p q n a

definitions.name: lw_pre
definitions.equation:
lw_pre image p q n different <=>
    bp_e2_crypto_pre 0x10241840 (word 0x300008) (word 0x400000)
      p q n (lw_memory image p q n different) (lw_read p q n) lw_execute
      (lw_ordinary p q n) (lw_state image p q n different)

definitions.name: fb_initialized_rw
definitions.equation: fb_initialized_rw a <=> 0x10422e50 <= a /\ a < 0x104895b0

definitions.name: fb_reference_image
definitions.equation:
fb_reference_image (file_bytes:num->byte) (initial_rw:int64->byte)
                     (padding:int64->byte) (a:int64) =
    if fb_immutable (val a) then file_bytes (val a-0x10000000)
    else if fb_initialized_rw (val a) then initial_rw a
    else padding a

definitions.name: fb_full_image
definitions.equation:
fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding (image:int64->byte) <=>
    !a. lw_image_domain (val(a:int64))
        ==> image a = fb_reference_image file_bytes initial_rw padding a

definitions.name: fb_file_code
definitions.equation:
fb_file_code (file_bytes:num->byte) <=>
    !i. i<95 ==> file_bytes(0x241840+i) = EL i crypto_memcmp_mc

definitions.name: fb_read
definitions.equation: fb_read p q n a <=> lw_read p q n a \/ fb_tls_page a

definitions.name: fb_ordinary
definitions.equation: fb_ordinary p q n a <=> lw_ordinary p q n a \/ fb_tls_page a

definitions.name: fb_initial_abi
definitions.equation:
fb_initial_abi = abi_omitted_state_RECORD
    (word 0x37f) (word 0) (word 0xffff) (word 0)
    (word 0) (word 0) (word 0) (word 0)
    (\r:(3)word. word 0) (word 0x1f80)
    (word 0) (word 0x500000) (word 0) (word 0)

definitions.name: fb_abi_initial_fields
definitions.equation:
fb_abi_initial_fields (a:abi_omitted_state) <=>
    read ABI_X87_CW a = word 0x37f /\
    read ABI_X87_SW a = word 0 /\
    read ABI_X87_TAG a = word 0xffff /\
    read ABI_X87_FOP a = word 0 /\
    read ABI_X87_IP a = word 0 /\
    read ABI_X87_CS a = word 0 /\
    read ABI_X87_DP a = word 0 /\
    read ABI_X87_DS a = word 0 /\
    (!r:(3)word. read ABI_X87_REGS a r = word 0) /\
    read ABI_MXCSR a = word 0x1f80 /\
    read ABI_FS_SELECTOR a = word 0 /\
    read ABI_FS_BASE a = word 0x500000 /\
    read ABI_GS_SELECTOR a = word 0 /\
    read ABI_GS_BASE a = word 0

definitions.name: fb_machine
definitions.equation:
fb_machine image p q n different =
    (lw_state image p q n different,fb_initial_abi)

definitions.name: fb_pre
definitions.equation:
fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image p q n different <=>
    fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding
      (read memory (FST(fb_machine image p q n different))) /\
    bp_e2_crypto_pre 0x10241840 (word 0x300008) (word 0x400000)
      p q n (lw_memory image p q n different) (fb_read p q n) lw_execute
      (fb_ordinary p q n) (FST(fb_machine image p q n different)) /\
    fb_abi_initial_fields (SND(fb_machine image p q n different)) /\
    (!a. fb_tls_page a ==> fb_read p q n a /\ fb_ordinary p q n a) /\
    assurance_canonical48 (val(read ABI_FS_BASE
      (SND(fb_machine image p q n different))))

definitions.name: assurance_canonical48
definitions.equation:
assurance_canonical48 a <=>
    a < 2 EXP 64 /\ (a < 2 EXP 47 \/ 2 EXP 64 - 2 EXP 47 <= a)

definitions.name: assurance_region
definitions.equation: assurance_region (p:int64) n a <=> val p <= a /\ a < val p+n

definitions.name: assurance_span_ok
definitions.equation:
assurance_span_ok perm a width <=>
    a+width <= 2 EXP 64 /\
    !j. j < width ==> assurance_canonical48 (a+j) /\ perm(a+j)

definitions.name: bp_e2_cleanse_pre
definitions.equation:
bp_e2_cleanse_pre pc stackpointer ra p n m rp wp xp ordinary (s:x86state) <=>
    n<2 EXP 64 /\ pc+97<=2 EXP 64 /\
    bytes_loaded s (word pc) openssl_cleanse_mc /\
    read RIP s=word pc /\ read RSP s=stackpointer /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s=ra /\
    C_ARGUMENTS [p;word n] s /\ read memory s=m /\
    val(stackpointer:int64) MOD 16=8 /\ val stackpointer+8<2 EXP 64 /\
    assurance_canonical48(val(ra:int64)) /\ ~(ra=word pc) /\
    read DF s=F /\ ~bit 18(read rflags s) /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) pc 97 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val stackpointer) 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. wp a /\ ordinary a) (val(p:int64)) n /\
    (!a. ~(assurance_region p n a /\ assurance_region (word pc) 97 a)) /\
    (!a. ~(assurance_region p n a /\ assurance_region stackpointer 8 a))
